title: Aerated Norwegian Herbal Stir-fry
description: A light and refreshing stir-fry featuring red wine jelly and Norwegian herbs. Serve raw-friendly and enjoy the simplicity of this aerated dish.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the red onion and saut2e until translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add the parsley, dill, and fennel seeds, and saut2e for an additional 2 minutes.
Stir in the honey and red wine jelly until combined.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Bring the water to a boil in a separate pot, then reduce heat to low.
Slowly pour the hot water into the skillet with the stir-fry mixture, creating air pockets as you go.
Stir gently to combine, being careful not to deflate the aerated mixture.
Transfer the stir-fry to a serving dish and garnish with fresh chives and a drizzle of rice vinegar.
Serve chilled or at room temperature.
